sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

This application has been filed with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings of summoning order dated 24.05.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate-III Saharanpur, as well as the entire criminal proceedings in Complaint Case No. 29 of 2022 (Smt. Asma Vs. Afzal and others, under section- 498A, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Biharigarh, District- Saharanpur,
pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate- III, Saharanpur, District- Saharanpur.
There is matrimonial dispute between the parties on account of non-fulfillment of demand of dowry.
Submission is that the matter be referred to Mediation Centre of this Court.

sentences.text: In the facts of the present case, we are of the view that an attempt be made to resolve the differences between the parties by way of mediation.

It is, therefore, directed that applicant shall deposit a sum of Rs. 30,000/- within two weeks from today with the Mediation Centre out of which Rs. 25,000/-
shall be paid to the respondent no. 2 for appearance before the Mediation Centre.
The remaining amount of Rs. 5,000/- shall go to mediation centre towards the expenses of mediation.
The matter is remitted to the Mediation Centre with the direction that same may be resolved after giving notices to both the parties.

It is directed that Mediation Centre shall make all endeavours to resolve the dispute amicably,
expeditiously, preferably within a period of three months.
List after three months.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant pursuant to the aforesaid complaint case.
After depositing the amount as aforesaid, notice shall be issued to the parties.
In the event of failure of compliance, the application shall stand dismissed without reference to the Court.
